externalRequiredEqualities: two independent full-file SHA-256 methods agree at each phase and equal the frozen expected SHA-256
all 64 KiB chunk digests agree across all phases
normalized path, NTFS file ID, length, creation time, last-write time and PE identity remain stable

liveProcessRequiredIdentity: exact command line containing only the authorized execute method and isolated project

terminalRule: Pass only if all three external fingerprints and the composite live-process identity satisfy the frozen rule, in-process structural identity remains stable, exactly one isolated algorithm-free Unity probe occurs, all prior evidence remains unchanged, and no prohibited action occurs. File.ReadAllBytes or any other in-process byte-read hash may differ without causing identity failure because it is diagnostic only. Any authoritative-identity mismatch, structural-identity mismatch, compile failure or process failure consumes attempt-004 and fails closed without retry.
